ideas.pitch: A private Bitcoin tipping plugin for Nostr clients utilizing zero-knowledge proofs to break the public link between npub and lightning invoice destinations.
ideas.title: NostrZkPay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets both the Privacy and Nostr tracks by solving a major metadata leak in social payments, aligning with Bitshala's ethos of deep cryptographic privacy.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent running locally that manages a Core Lightning node, automatically rebalancing channels and executing submarine swaps based on network fee heuristics.
ideas.title: SatsAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the AI track with hardcore Bitcoin infrastructure, appealing to judges looking for functional utility rather than generic wrappers.

ideas.pitch: A minimal Nostr-backed coordination relay specifically designed for asynchronous CoinJoin rounds without centralized coordinators.
ideas.title: CoinJoinRelay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages Nostr for censorship-resistant peer discovery in privacy-enhancing financial tools, ticking both major track preferences of the sponsor.

ideas.pitch: A browser extension that allows users to sign Nostr events and Bitcoin PSBTs using an air-gapped hardware simulator via QR codes.
ideas.title: SilentSigner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on sovereign key management and user privacy, which aligns closely with the core ethos of Bitshala's educational stack.

ideas.pitch: An LLM-powered Nostr bot that verifies open-source Bitcoin pull requests and posts cryptographic attestations of code safety directly to the relay network.
ideas.title: NostrOracleAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings cutting-edge AI verification tools directly into the Bitcoin developer workflow, directly addressing the AI and Nostr themes.
